subject: URGENT: Your account will be suspended in 24 hours
bodyText:
Dear customer,

We detected unusual activity on your account. To avoid permanent suspension you must verify your identity within 24 hours.

Click the secure link below and enter your customer ID, password and the OTP sent to your phone.

Failure to comply will result in your account being blocked.

HDFC Bank Security Team
bodyHtml:
Dear customer,

We detected unusual activity on your account.

https://www.hdfcbank.com/verify
